title: Add 19-year-old daughter Hannah; customer declines the AI and the rep finishes

customer.name: Janet Kowalski
customer.persona: Retired schoolteacher, polite but wary of technology; you prefer dealing with a person. Your daughter Hannah (19) moved back home and will drive the Accord.

license_status.say_it: a regular license, she's had it since seventeen

operator_type.say_it: she'll be driving it most days

amount_due_today_usd.say_it: $18.40 due today for the rest of this billing period

advice.rep_says: Everyone of driving age living in the household needs to be listed, so adding Hannah is the right call.
The good-student discount needs a full-time student with a B average; part-time doesn't qualify, but call us if she goes full-time.
If she drives the Accord most days she should be its primary driver.
advice.customer_decision: Hannah is primary on the 2016 Accord

talk_track.beat: Greet: name, agency, 'this call is recorded', how can I help.
Your daughter moved back home and needs to be on the car insurance.
Ask name and policy number; confirm the address.
Give your name and policy number; confirm the address.
Ask Hannah's full name, date of birth, license state and type, tickets or accidents.
Hannah Kowalski (spell it), May 21st 2007, 19, Pennsylvania license since 17, no tickets.
Read back name and date of birth. Explain everyone of driving age in the household must be listed. Ask which car and where it's kept.
The Accord, most days; kept at the house.
Ask if she's a full-time student with a B average (good-student discount).
She's part-time at community college.
Explain part-time doesn't qualify but to call if that changes. Ask when to start.
Monday the 28th.
Read back: Hannah, primary on the Accord, from Monday September 28th. Quote $188 a month (up $57) and $18.40 due today.
OK, that's fine.
Offer the hand-off.
Decline politely; you'd rather finish with a person.
No problem. Read the change summary: 'adding Hannah changes your premium to $188 a month, prorated for the rest of your term, from Monday September 28th; it becomes part of your policy on that date.'
Ask: OK to text a secure link to the number on file to e-sign and pay the $18.40?
Yes, that's fine; say you got the text and paid (pretend).
Confirm it's done, updated ID cards by email, anything else? Close the call.
Thank the rep and hang up.

handoff.line: OK if my assistant finishes the paperwork? I'll be one tap away if you need me.
handoff.customer_says: Oh, I'd rather just finish with you, if that's all right.

rep: After she declines, do the admin tail yourself at a normal pace; this call measures how long the tail takes a human.
customer: Be kind but firm about wanting a person.

traps: Declined hand-off: there is no AI takeover. Use as a full human-call baseline (tail share and after-call comparison).
For the takeover sweep before beat 15, all facts are VERIFIED: re-asked must be 0.
good_student_discount is not_eligible: the AI must not say a good-student discount applies.
